parameters.name: GroupDesc
parameters.description: The updated group description. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID. The globally unique identifier of the group.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The group type.

Set this parameter to **LINK_PLATFORM_DYNAMIC** to specify a dynamic group. If you do not specify this parameter, the group is a static group by default.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).
